* [Core Event] Researchers from Alibaba and several Asian universities: Revealed that AI coding agents only fully complete 26.4% of real-world tasks, with the majority requiring manual human intervention.
* [Root Cause & Mechanism] Previous benchmarks had become too saturated and easy, failing to reflect actual coding performance.
* [Key Metrics] Top models only achieve ~26% full task completion.
* [Perspective & Impact] Existing coding benchmarks have become decoupled from real-world utility.
